summary: FT-030 rev 3, owned path crates/paragraph-layout (the legacy branch name 'table-layout' does not correspond to any crate in this repo; crates/table-layout was not created). Consumed the existing font-engine metrics/encoding callback (flashtex_font_engine::adapters::paragraph::FaceMetrics implementing this crate's own FontMetricsSource, crates/font-engine/src/adapters/paragraph.rs) as a [dev-dependencies]-only path dependency (flashtex-font-engine, flashtex-compiler); the shipped library still has zero dependencies and neither peer crate was edited. Added src/adapter.rs: MAX_DIMEN_PT (16383.99998, TeX's max_dimen)/MAX_ITEMS (200000) bounds, a typed LayoutError, and try_layout_paragraph, which validates every dimension and the item count before the breaker runs and catch_unwinds it as a defense-in-depth backstop -- deliberately not a rewrite of the existing f64-based breaker to integer scaled points, documented as a scope decision, not an oversight. Added tests/adversarial.rs (12 tests: empty input, zero-width/combining/RTL-override/NUL characters, non-NFC Unicode, an 8000-word paragraph, a single unbreakable 500-char word against a 10pt line, and INFINITE_PENALTY/FORCED_BREAK/MAX_DIMEN boundaries at and one past each bound -- valid-but-unusual inputs assert Ok with documented behavior, only genuine bound violations assert typed Err). Added tests/hyphenation_spans.rs (3 tests) proving source-span honesty at a hyphenation point for both ExplicitDiscretionary (the \- marker's 2 bytes are real source text) and a local automatic-hyphenator stand-in (marker_len 0: the generated hyphen's span is asserted empty, point..point, never a false claim on real bytes), including once through the real font-engine callback. Added tests/mismatch_fixtures.rs (2 tests): a pinned, reproducible break/position mismatch between this crate's total-fit breaker and the real consumer's (crates/compiler) greedy layout, same font/size/measure, hyphenation off both sides, across a 14-document corpus -- 5 of 14 documents break differently, 8 differing break positions total, plus one worked glyph-position mismatch pinned to exact points (word 'how', doc 1: compiler places it at page x=72.0 as a new line; this crate keeps it on the prior line at page x=519.6360000000001, 447.6360000000001pt apart). No reference engine copied or ported; no TeX parity claimed. cargo test: 54 passed, 0 failed (18 unit + 12 adversarial + 16 golden [pre-existing] + 3 hyphenation_spans + 2 mismatch_fixtures + 2 oracle_wrap_sample [pre-existing] + 1 doctest). cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings: exit 0, clean.
